test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A teacher calculated the average marks of 15 students in a test as 72.4. Later, she found that the marks of one student were wrongly entered as 68.9 instead of 86.3. After correcting the error, what is the correct average mark of the class?
solution:
**Given:**

Average marks of 15 students = 72.4

Incorrect marks of one student = 68.9

Correct marks of the same student = 86.3

**Formula used:**

Corrected Average = dfrac{{(Sum of marks) + (Correction)}}{{Number of students}}

Correction = Correct marks - Incorrect marks

**Calculation:**

Correction = 86.3 - 68.9

⇒ Correction = 17.4

Sum of marks = Average × Number of students

Sum of marks = 72.4 × 15

⇒ Sum of marks = 1086

Corrected Sum of marks = 1086 + 17.4

⇒ Corrected Sum of marks = 1103.4

Corrected Average = dfrac{1103.4}{15}

⇒ Corrected Average = 73.56

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
